items.reason: final_head_commit and a review-document commit are not authoritative review endpoints. Plan 217 is now v1.2, addressing the closure addendum on R2, R3 and R5. Budget row scores and Addresses cells are unchanged. R1 and R4 are untouched. Document-only: I ran no tests, and the plan still parses (phases, budget table, plan document).

Proof-bound corrections and evidence-only paths are the other allowed cases. Uncovered pre-admission and inter-phase code is rejected. Legacy runs use actual author and reviewer endpoints, or stop.
